meta.description: A dark, text-based, choice-driven RPG. Hunt, loot, delve. The world is mysterious. The world is dangerous.

title.motto: The world is mysterious. The world is dangerous. You have a sword.
title.noSignup: No sign-up: you play right away. You can save your account later.
title.footer: A project from 2022, raised from the dead. Up to 3 heroes per account.

chronicle.title: Chronicle
chronicle.empty: Nothing has been written yet. Go hunt something.

camp.title: The Camp
day: The day is grey, as always.
A cold wind comes down from the hills.
night: Night has fallen. The moonblades are singing.
It is dark. Something prowls at the treeline.
camp.bloodMoonText: Tonight, enemies are stronger. Gold and magic find are doubled.
camp.restReady: The fire crackles. You may rest once today: health and energy fully restored.
camp.restDone: You have already rested today. The fire will wait for you tomorrow.
camp.leaderboardText: The greatest heroes in the world.

hunt.title: Hunting grounds
hunt.intro: Choose your difficulty. The more dangerous, the better the loot.

flavor.easy: Lost goblins, tired skeletons. Enough to warm up.
flavor.normal: The edge of the forest. Things bite for real here.
flavor.hard: The enemies are a level ahead of you. Drink a potion first.
flavor.hell: No one comes back from Hell unscathed. Those who come back are rich.

hunt.weeklyText: Once a week. Guaranteed rare loot, a one-in-two chance of legendary, and 25 shards.
hunt.lowHealth: Your health is low. Drink a potion or rest at camp before you hunt.
hunt.tormentText: Beyond level 20: stronger enemies (+{level} levels), rewards +{reward}%, magic find +{mf}%.
hunt.mercy: Mercy {level}: enemies are {pct}% weaker after your defeats.
hunt.beginner: First steps: hunts cost half until level 5.

challenge.title: The daily challenge
challenge.text: The same {fights} enemies for everyone, the same ready-made hero, three potions. One attempt per day.
challenge.comeBack: Come back tomorrow for a new challenge.

combat.title: Combat
combat.autoHint: Automatic combat. Hands control back to you below 30% health.
combat.defeatHint: You wake up at camp, bruised and a little poorer. Rest or drink a potion.
combat.defeatDungeonHint: The loot from the depths is lost. Your experience, at least, remains.

dungeon.title: Beneath the city
dungeon.intro: Floors of rooms behind doors. Choose your path. A guardian waits every 5 floors.
dungeon.rules: What you find down there stays in your satchel until you get out. Die, and it is all lost, except the experience.
dungeon.oneDoor: A single door. Behind it, something is breathing.
dungeon.stairsText: Go back up with your loot, or descend further. Deeper means richer, and deadlier.
dungeon.stashHint: Lost if you die before getting out.

hero.statsHint: Luck also raises critical chance (0.75% per point) and level-up bonuses.
hero.chooseClassText: This choice is final. You will receive a weapon of your class.
hero.paragonText: Beyond level 20, every experience threshold grants you a point to spend. Progress never ends.
hero.sigilsEmpty: No sigil worn. Two pieces of the same sigil are enough for a first bonus.

quests.title: Quests
quests.dailyDone: All of today's quests are done. Come back tomorrow.
quests.boardEmpty: Nothing left on the board today.
quests.actDone: Act I is over. The rest of the story is still buried.

market.title: The market
market.intro: The wares change every morning. One of each, no more.

forge.title: The forge
forge.intro: Upgrade your items up to +{max}, or reroll their affixes for shards.
forge.risk: {pct}% chance of failure. The item is never destroyed.
forge.limit: Your forge can go no further. Upgrade it at camp.
forge.rerollText: Replaces one affix with another at random, never on an attribute already present.
forge.salvageHint: To salvage an item into shards, open it from your bag. Upgrade the {building} at camp to go higher.

fishing.title: Fishing
fishing.needRod: You need an equipped rod (from the market) and some bait.
fishing.escaped: The line goes slack. The fish is gone.
fishing.help: Line thrashing: give slack. Fish circling: hold steady. Fish tiring: pull. Cunning fish sometimes lie.

codex.title: Codex
codex.unknownLore: You have never slain one. Yet.
codex.oddsText: Base chances per fight, before your magic find. Elites roll twice, bosses three times with a guaranteed rare item.
codex.pity: Bad-luck protection: {pity} win(s) without a legendary, so +{bonus}% on the next roll.

leaderboard.title: Leaderboard
leaderboard.hint: Your hero is shown in gold.
leaderboard.dailyHint: The challenge changes at midnight. Same enemies, same hero for everyone.

settings.title: Settings
settings.installHint: On iPhone: Share, then "Add to Home Screen". On Android and desktop, your browser offers it too.
settings.pushEnable: Notify me when my energy is full
settings.pushOn: Noted. One notification a day, at most.
settings.pushDenied: Notifications are blocked in your browser.
settings.pushUnavailable: Notifications are not configured on this server.
settings.deleteConfirm: Delete {name} forever? There is no undoing this.
settings.creditsText: TextRPG was born in 2022 as FightingText: a Python RPG, in a terminal. This version is its rebirth.

account.title: Account
account.claimText: You are playing as a guest. Add an email and a password to find your heroes on any device.
account.loginText: Sign in: the heroes you created here as a guest will follow you.

celebrate.paragonHint: A point to spend on the Hero screen.
celebrate.classHint: You can choose your class on the Hero screen.

combatStart: {enemy} saw you before you saw it.
heroExtra: Faster than its foe, {hero} strikes again: {damage}.
A second blow, before it can react: {damage}.
heroDodge: You slip away at the last moment.
The blow cleaves the air where you stood.
enemyDodge: Your blade meets only empty air.
log.stunned: {enemy} is stunned and can do nothing.

heal.lifeSteal: You drink a little of its life: +{amount}.

windup: {enemy} draws a deep breath… Raise your guard!
{enemy} winds up. The next blow will be terrible.
Silence. {enemy} is getting ready. Guard yourself!
log.bastion: You should be dead. You are not.
log.counter: You counterattack in the same motion!
log.mystery: The mysterious ring awakens: your {stat} is doubled.
log.fleeFailed: You try to flee… it catches you.
log.defeat: Everything goes black. You lose {gold} gold.
log.defeatDungeon: The depths got you. Your satchel is lost, and {gold} gold with it.
log.lootLost: {item}, but your bag is full. Left behind.
log.rested: You rest by the fire. Flame: {streak} day(s).
log.identified: The veil lifts from the item.
log.upgradeFailed: The metal resists. Nothing has changed.

room.fight: You push the door open. Something is waiting.

log.trapDodged: You leap in time. The trap snaps shut on nothing.
log.stairs: End of floor {floor}. A staircase leads down.
log.dungeonLeft: You return to the surface: {items} item(s), {gold} gold.
log.classUnlocked: You can now choose your class.
log.transmuted: The Cube rumbles. Out comes a {rarity} item.
log.enchanted: The enchantment takes. The item hums softly.
log.infused: The {sigil} sigil sinks into the metal.
log.reforged: The Cube recasts the item. Nothing is as it was.
log.extracted: The legendary dissolves; its power stays in the Cube.
log.tormentOff: You return to a world without torment.

errors.server: The world faltered. Try again in a moment.
errors.offline: No connection. Try again when the signal returns.
errors.offlineBanner: Offline. Reconnect to resume the hunt.
errors.noSession: Your session has expired. Reload the page.
errors.tooFast: Easy, adventurer. One action at a time.
errors.conflict: Your game changed elsewhere (another tab?). Reload the page.
errors.invalidName: Choose a name at least 2 letters long.
errors.invalidEmail: This email address is not valid.
errors.weakPassword: The password must be at least 8 characters.
errors.emailTaken: This address is already in use. Sign in instead.
errors.alreadyFull: You don't need that right now.
errors.atStairs: You are at the stairs: go down or go back up.
errors.cannotFlee: There is no fleeing this fight.
errors.challengeDone: You have already taken today's challenge.
errors.fishing: Your line is in the water.
errors.forgeLimit: Your forge can go no further.
errors.inCombat: You are in the middle of a fight.
errors.noRod: You need an equipped fishing rod.
errors.notEnoughEnergy: Not enough energy ({needed} needed). Rest or wait.
errors.notInDungeon: You are not in the depths.
errors.notUsable: This item cannot be used that way.
errors.questLogFull: Your journal is full (3 board quests).
errors.unknownOffer: This offer is no longer available.
errors.weeklyDone: The weekly boss is already slain.
errors.sameRarity: All three items must share a rarity.
errors.cannotInfuse: Set items already have their lineage.
errors.noPower: There is no power to keep.
errors.alreadyExtracted: This power is already in the Cube.
errors.tormentLocked: This torment is not within your reach yet.
errors.notForCube: Tools don't go in the Cube.

origin.dungeon: Brought up from the Depths, floor {floor}
origin.class: A gift from your new path

procs.hit_burn: {chance}% chance on hit to set the enemy ablaze: {value}% of the damage per turn for {turns} turns
procs.hit_poison: {chance}% chance on hit to poison: {value}% of the damage per turn for {turns} turns
procs.hit_bleed: {chance}% chance on hit to cause bleeding: {value}% of the damage per turn for {turns} turns
procs.hit_chill: {chance}% chance on hit to chill the enemy for {turns} turns
procs.hit_stun: {chance}% chance on hit to stun the enemy
procs.hit_weaken: {chance}% chance on hit to weaken the enemy for {turns} turns
procs.hit_lifesteal: Every hit heals you for {value}% of the damage dealt
procs.crit_damage: Your critical hits deal {value}% more damage
procs.crit_heal: Every critical hit restores {value}% of your health
procs.kill_heal: Killing an enemy restores {value}% of your health
procs.start_evasive: You start every fight evasive for {turns} turns
procs.start_strike: You open every fight with a {value}% strike (never lethal)
procs.turn_strike: Every {every} turns, an extra strike for {value}%
procs.struck_retaliate: {chance}% chance when struck to strike back for {value}%
procs.low_empower: Below 35% health, you are empowered for {turns} turns (once per fight)
procs.low_heal: Below 30% health, you recover {value}% of your health (once per fight)

cube.title: The Cube
cube.intro: A cube of black stone that hums when you come near. Nothing you put in comes out the same.
cube.transmuteText: Three items of the same rarity become one of the next rarity. The first one you pick decides the slot.
cube.enchantText: The Cube shows you three enchantments for an item; you keep one. An item carries a single enchantment: a new one replaces the old.
cube.infuseText: Give an item the sigil of another. The donor is destroyed.
cube.reforgeText: Recasts every property of a rare or legendary item. The best or the worst may come out.
cube.powersText: Destroy a legendary to keep its power, then place powers in the Cube's slots: they work as if you wore the item.
